title: The “Nuisance of Marijuana Smoke” Is An Artifact of Prohibition

content_html_sanitized:
I was born in 1940, so I grew up in a cloud of cigarette smoke. There were no “No Smoking” signs, much less No Smoking areas, except in close proximity to explosives.

 

Even on airplanes.

 

Plus, Cigarettes were advertised everywhere, including kiddies cartoon shows. I never smoked, but both my parents did and somehow it never bothered me. Since then smoking became unfashionable and smoking rates have fallen dramatically. Amazingly, this happened without arresting tens of millions of Americans.

 

Meanwhile, while arresting tens of millions of Americans, the rate of marijuana use went from virtually zero to tens of millions. In densely populated areas, marijuana decriminalization brought back the smoke, which didn’t bother me, but did bother lots of people.

 

In very densely populated New York City, this became a problem when the state and the city made a mess of the legalization process, resulting in illegal stores everywhere selling bud, but with no place to smoke it, except on the street.

 

From 2021 See NYPD Concerned They Won’t Be Able to Arrest People for Smoking Weed in Public, So Smoke-Easies to the Rescue

 

Even (especially) in the UK

See Beyond Parody, Actual Headline in London Tabloid:“Top police chiefs say smell of cannabis is a 'sign of crime' that can make even them feel 'unsafe'... and frontline officers should 'do something about it'

And

Cannabis Retail Outlets: What’s In A Name? What Is The Best Model?

And

Why Does Newsweek Push Prohibitionist Propaganda?

 

Of course, vape pens could also have prevented that problem, if the thousands of bodegas that sell beer and cigarettes (and tobacco leaves for rolling blunts) were allowed to sell vapes.

 

Still, there are other “cultural” aspects to this problem. We are told that smoking on the streets shows a disrespect for the law!

 

Precisely. Why should anyone respect the laws that have been used so hypocritically, so unjustly, indeed so cruelly?

Charlie Kirk, Big Time “Christian Nationalist”, Wants Trump to Keep Cannabis In Schedule One, So Kids Won’t Have To Smell Smoke In The Park. Jesus Wept
